intro: Firehouse Subs is the firefighter-founded chain known for its hot, steamed subs, piled with meats and cheese that are steamed to bring out the flavor, then served on a toasted roll. Signatures include the Hook & Ladder, the Italian, and the hearty Smokehouse Beef & Cheddar Brisket, plus the Firehouse Meatball. Subs come in Medium and Large, and a portion of every sale supports the Firehouse Subs Public Safety Foundation. Prices and calories below are for a Medium. Below is the full Firehouse Subs menu with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: A Medium sub at Firehouse Subs is about $10.49 to $11.49, with the Hook & Ladder and Italian at $10.49 and the Smokehouse Brisket at $11.49. A Large runs about $3 more. The Veggie is the cheapest at $9.49. Subs are steamed hot. A Medium Hook & Ladder is about 600 calories.
hot_deal: Firehouse Subs value: the Firehouse Rewards app drops points toward free subs plus a birthday reward and regular offers. A Medium sub is plenty for most, and the Veggie ($9.49) is the cheapest. Rounding up for the Public Safety Foundation at checkout is how the chain funds equipment for first responders. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: What is Firehouse Subs known for?
faqs.a: Firehouse Subs is known for hot, steamed subs: the meats and cheese are steamed to bring out the flavor before being piled on a toasted roll. It was founded by firefighter brothers, and it supports a Public Safety Foundation that funds equipment for first responders.

faqs.q: How much is a sub at Firehouse Subs?
faqs.a: A Medium sub is about $10.49 to $11.49, and a Large runs about $3 more. The Hook & Ladder and Italian are $10.49 Medium, the Smokehouse Brisket is $11.49, and the Veggie is the cheapest at $9.49.

faqs.q: What sizes does Firehouse Subs offer?
faqs.a: Two: Medium and Large. The Medium is the standard single-person size and the Large is longer, for a big appetite or to split. Most subs are also offered as a salad bowl without the bread.

faqs.q: How many calories are in a Firehouse sub?
faqs.a: A Medium Hook & Ladder is about 600 calories and the Engineer is about 500. Heartier subs run higher, like the Italian at about 770 and the Smokehouse Brisket at about 900. Ordering a salad bowl cuts the calories.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Firehouse Subs?
faqs.a: The best known are the Hook & Ladder, the Italian, the Smokehouse Beef & Cheddar Brisket, the Firehouse Meatball, and the New York Steamer.
